recognize_zh: 血液抹片中可同時見到骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀核、分節嗜中性球，加上兩顆深紫黑色顆粒的嗜鹼性球與嗜伊紅性球，這種「完整左移＋嗜鹼性球、嗜伊紅性球增多」是 CML 的典型組合。
features: Marked leukocytosis with granulocytes at every maturation stage
Two basophils with coarse dark purple-black granules
Eosinophils with orange refractile granules, including an eosinophilic myelocyte
Clustered myelocytes and promyelocytes with round nuclei and granular cytoplasm
Blasts not increased; no dysplasia of neutrophils
Platelets present; red cells with mild anisocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with a complete spectrum of granulocytic maturation from promyelocytes to segmented neutrophils, with a predominance of myelocytes and mature neutrophils. Basophils and eosinophils are increased, and blasts are not increased in this field. There is no granulocytic dysplasia. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, chronic phase.

ddx.vs: A leukemoid reaction lacks basophilia and eosinophilia and shows toxic granulation, with a high LAP score.
aCML has dysplastic granulocytes and basophils under 2%.
CEL is dominated by eosinophils rather than a myelocyte-rich neutrophilic series with basophils.
